review:
Gates of Olympus POP shrinks Zeus's game onto a compact 3×5 grid. Five to nine or more matching symbols anywhere pay, tumbles follow each win, and multiplier symbols with values up to 1,000x can land in both the base game and the bonus. They stay on screen through the tumble sequence and are added together at the end.

Three or more scatters or Super Scatters start 15 free spins, with five more for two further scatters, and multipliers on winning spins build a running total. Scatter and Super Scatter combinations in the base game can also award one of three jackpots, up to 25,000x. Pragmatic lists a 96.54% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
